english.title: Apply / administer / attempt / cause to be taken a drug with intent to commit an indictable offence
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) unlawfully

(A)_[applied or administered to]_
(B)_[caused to be taken by]_
(C)_[attempted to apply or administer to]_
(D)_[attempted to cause to be administered to or taken by]_

**(..SPECIFY PERSON..)

(E)_[chloroform]_
(F)_[laudanum]_
(G)_[a stupefying or overpowering drug, matter or thing, namely **(..SPECIFY DRUG..),]_

with intent thereby to

(H)_[enable you to commit]_
(I)_[enable another person to commit]_
(J)_[assist another person in committing]_

an indictable offence, namely **(..SPECIFY OFFENCE..).
english.legislation: Contrary to section 22 of the Offences Against the Person Act 1861.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
unlawfully applied or administered/caused to be taken/attempted to apply or administer/attempted
to cause to be administered or taken chloroform/laudanum/stupefying or overpowering drug/matter/thing
with intent to enable self/another to commit/assist another to commit an indictable offence

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) In this instance 'indictable' includes offences triable 'either way'.
(ii) See H2003 for a similar, but more serious offence of administering with intent to endanger life.
(iii) See H2002 for a similar, but less serious offence than (ii) above - administering poison with intent to injure/aggrieve/annoy.
(iv) See H2001 for the offence wording relating to administer drug to obtain intercourse.

other.penalty:
Life imprisonment.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None
